target.title: fix(gateway): always enforce path containment for session transcript archive
target.body:
## Summary

Always enforce path containment when archiving session transcript files.
Previously `restrictToStoreDir` was opt-in; remove the flag and always
validate archived files reside under the sessions directory.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: Session transcript archive respected an opt-in restrictToStoreDir flag, allowing unchecked paths when not set.

**Real environment tested**: Linux 4.19.112, Node 22.19.0, pnpm 11.2.2

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:
```bash
pnpm test -- src/gateway/session-transcript-files.fs.archive-events.test.ts
```

**After-fix evidence**:
```
Test Files  4 passed (4)
     Tests  20 passed (20)
```

**Observed result after the fix**: All 20 tests pass. Path containment is always enforced.

**What was not tested**: Archive operation with a poisoned sessionFile field in the database.

## Tests and validation

```
pnpm test -- src/gateway/session-transcript-files.fs.archive-events.test.ts — 20 passed
```

## Risk checklist

- [x] This change is backwards compatible — containment already used by most callers
- [x] This change has been tested with existing configurations — 20 tests pass
- [x] I have updated relevant documentation — no docs changes needed
- [x] Breaking changes (if any) are documented in Summary — none
